name: insomnia-collection
description: Public Graph beta requests with private local variables and a human/agent walkthrough.

inputs.name: access_token
inputs.description: Required Microsoft Graph delegated token; set only in the private local Insomnia environment.

inputs.name: playbook_definition_id
inputs.description: Catalog GUID required for getting a definition or creating a session; never use uniqueName as the ID.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.description: Returned session GUID required for session-specific reads or cancellation.

inputs.name: input_id
inputs.description: Opaque input ID returned for the selected session; required only for Get input.

inputs.name: output_id
inputs.description: Opaque output ID returned for the selected session; required for metadata or content reads.

inputs.name: agent_run_id
inputs.description: Run ID returned for the selected session; required only for Get agent run.

inputs.name: input_kind
inputs.description: Input kind accepted by the selected definition; required for the one-input creation example.

inputs.name: input_value
inputs.description: Authorized input identifier as a string; required for the one-input creation example.

inputs.name: write_access_token
inputs.description: Optional delegated Graph token with Perception.Manage.All; leave empty for reads and set privately only for explicitly approved writes.
